fit: Use the exact 216-map sibling economy_aux_dev training set, labels and permutation, same parent, 120 x 32 updates for two arms. Held maps never set bins, weights, threshold or model selection.
targets: H10,H30, each own deliveries, own tree receipts, rival deliveries, rival tree receipts. Exact zero plus eight positive equal-frequency bins; train-only mean within each cell is cash support. Empty cells masked. Every forecast is a convex mixture, including zero.
loss: CE/log(9) plus 0.25 times squared mean-cash error scaled by valid training SD (floor 25). Actor behavior loss and auxiliary coefficient unchanged. Common initialization. Control detaches context on the auxiliary task.
decision: If predicted rival freight over next 30 steps >=500, call for defensive reserve. Against realized freight>=500 charge FP=1 FN=2. This is a predeclared diagnostic loss, not an action outcome.
priority: Fresh panel primary: map-equal rival freight H30 cash MAE and absolute signed bias against previous joint log estimate. Compare matched distribution control separately. Report tail misses, support overruns, both seats, registration novelty, all 8 channels and policy NLL. Three or more current rival collectors was the original congested subgroup.
panels: 18 and 21 prior maps are known diagnostic panels. New non-Master6 perspective panel picked without outcome/model predictions, held from this training family by game, seed and layout. Earlier broad scouting may include recordings. No native matches here.
